title: Newmark Advises on Sale and Financing of The Offices at Riverpark in Redmond, Washington
summary: Newmark announces that the company assisted KBS with the successful sale of The Offices at Riverpark, a 107,029-square-foot Class A office and medical office building located at 15809 Bear Creek Parkway in downtown Redmond, WA.
